# Tidewater operations handbook

## Fleet

| Vessel | Passengers | Vehicles |
|---|---|---|
| MV Kestrel | 212 | 40 |
| MV Osprey | 150 | none (foot passengers only) |

## Routes

- Harlow ↔ Pellin Island: 55 minutes, served by both vessels.
- Harlow ↔ Dunmere: 1 hour 20 minutes, MV Kestrel only.

## Check-in

Check-in closes 20 minutes before departure for foot passengers and
45 minutes before departure for vehicles. Late vehicles are moved to the next
sailing with space.

## Weather limits

The duty manager cancels a sailing when sustained winds exceed 38 knots or
the swell forecast at Pellin Island is above 3 metres. The on-call duty
manager is paged with the code TW-7.
